ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; dominant high-intensity off-white regions (approx. 80-85%) against low-intensity black perimeter and focal spots (approx. 15-20%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black banding along the trailing edge and distal tips; large central high-intensity off-white zones; diffuse ochre/tan mottling across central and distal regions; single dark elliptical focal spot on the lower-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations and stochastic scalloping patterns.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Predominantly convex sweep trajectory from the median notch to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark cluster near the median notch; distinct dark focal point on the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark pigmentation spot/anomaly on the lower-left lobe; irregular trailing edge morphology suggestive of cumulative wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive tan/yellowish bio-film or pigmentation staining covering a significant percentage of the high-intensity ventral regions.
